domain_label: Sweater Vertical — Quality Control Layers, the Contractual Yarn Spec, Incoming AQL & the Thread-Checker
purpose: A method for a micro D2C acrylic/blend knitwear brand (yarn sourced in Ludhiana, sweaters sold in California/Turlock) to reason about which QC it actually runs across three layers — yarn quality demanded via the purchase order, fabric/knit quality demanded from the knitter, and finished-garment AQL the brand alone owns — so that sense-and-grade capital is never bought, the contractual numeric yarn spec carries the leverage, incoming inspection has real willingness to reject, and the owner's thread-checker idea is decomposed into a don't-build sensor plus a cheap code-back loop, without ever fabricating a price, a throughput, or a job-work rate.
assumptions: no in-house metrology is owned; every yarn-evenness number is a contractual demand against supplier-owned Uster-class capital, never a reading taken on a brand-owned instrument

the product universe is a 3-article acrylic/cotton/merino California line at roughly $1-2.50 of fibre per garment, so any QC capital must stay proportionate to that input, not to an export mill's volume

every cost, price, throughput, MOQ and inspection-rate band is a labeled estimate carrying method, basis and confidence with the literal word estimate; a genuinely missing number such as the Ludhiana per-piece job-work or per-sample Uster rate stays UNKNOWN and is named as a blocker, never invented

USTER STATISTICS percentiles, ISO 2859-1 AQL, ISO 12945-1 pilling and the 4-point fabric system are pre-written public standards to be cited and demanded, not standards the brand authors or re-derives
off-paper or informal mechanisms in the cluster are described structurally as incentives, never as a named-party accusation, and their magnitude is UNKNOWN
exclusions: owning a USTER Tester 6, a yarn clearer, or any sensing-and-grading thread-checker device (premature, six-figure metrology moat, disproportionate to a $1-2.50/garment input)
stating a fabricated precise figure for any price, throughput, MOQ, lab-test cost, AQL inspection man-day rate or per-piece job-work charge as if it were a fact
the full landed-cost and unit-economics model (the lab-spot-check cost line feeds T4/T9; this KB does not build the margin model)
the consumer-facing digital-product-passport / brand-to-consumer traceability QR (a separate, later, marketing-driven option, not the supplier-accountability loop)
promising a magic device, building our own machine, or treating AI vision as a substitute for the human inspector rather than a multiplier

glossary.definition: The binding honesty label on every cost/price/throughput/MOQ band in this KB: a price or rate is a reasoned estimate carrying method, basis and confidence and the literal word estimate; a genuinely missing number (per-piece Ludhiana job-work rate, per-sample Uster run cost) stays UNKNOWN and is named as a blocker, never invented to look precise.

The three QC postures: the brand owns only finished-garment human AQL inspection; it demands yarn and fabric/knit sense-and-grade via the purchase order against supplier-owned capital; it buys finished-garment confirmation tests from a third-party lab. Confusing the three is the single most expensive QC mistake a small brand makes.

Where a yarn sits versus global production per parameter on USTER STATISTICS; 25% USTER means better than 75% of world production and a lower percentile is better. The PO language is must meet 25% USTER on CVm% and IPI; 5% USTER on a mainstream acrylic lot is unquotable or luxury-priced.

CVm% is the coefficient of variation of yarn mass (the headline evenness number, lower = more even); IPI is the Imperfection Index counting thin (-50%) + thick (+50%) + neps (+200%) per 1000 m. The two point-and-evenness numbers the PO spec and a reject decision turn on.

The ISO 2859-1 / ANSI-ASQ Z1.4 statistical sampling plan: pull a sample sized to the lot, count defects, accept or reject the whole batch on the count, at apparel-default acceptance levels Critical 0 / Major 2.5 / Minor 4.0.

Tester 6 is the off-line lab evenness tester (capacitive + optical) measuring CVm%/IPI/hairiness/count-CV/tenacity against USTER STATISTICS; Quantum is the in-line yarn clearer on the winder that checks the yarn thread-to-thread 100% inline and records every fault. Both are supplier-owned six-figure-class capital the brand never owns.

The ISO 12945-1 lab wear test rating pilling 1-5 (5 = no pill, 1 = severe); the objective gate behind any anti-pill claim, demanded at >=3-4 after at least one home wash because washing drops the grade and the post-wash grade is what predicts returns.

Linking joins panel edges loop-to-loop for a flat near-invisible stretchy seam, the defining quality step of a fully-fashioned sweater; mock-linking and overlocking imitate or substitute it more cheaply and signal cut-and-sew or value construction, a cost-down the incoming inspector must catch.

The buyer-to-supplier accountability sliver of the owner's thread-checker idea: log each lot's grade to a scorecard and emit a grade code / QR back to the named spinner. Nobody sells it turnkey because it is a contract instrument not a machine; ~$0-5k to build, with leverage conditional on the order being big enough that the spinner cares.

The binding limit on AI vision QC: vendor and paper accuracies of 91-96% come from specific datasets (TILDA, woven and jacquard fabrics), not our acrylic/blend stockinette and rib knits where loop texture, stretch, barre and melange noise confound; accuracy on our fabrics is UNKNOWN until validated on our own pre-production swatches, and even when it works vision assists the inspector, it does not replace him.

nodes.definition: Establish the mental model the whole strategy follows from: a sweater's quality is decided in three layers and the brand's leverage differs completely at each. Yarn quality (evenness, imperfections, strength) happens in the spinner's lab and on the winder where Uster-class capital lives; fabric/knit quality (defects in the knitted panel) happens on the knitter/CMT floor at the inspection frame; finished-garment quality (measurements, seams, finish, labels) happens at the brand's own incoming-goods table with a person, a tape and a light. Confusing the three is the single most expensive QC mistake a small brand makes, because it tempts a micro-brand to buy capital that already sits, better, on a supplier's floor.

who owns the machine at each layer
why confusing them is the costly mistake

pros.claim: Naming three layers with different ownership stops a micro-brand from buying capital that belongs on a supplier's floor
pros.example: seeing yarn evenness as the spinner's Uster-class layer prevents pricing a six-figure tester against a $1-2.50/garment input

cons.claim: A clean three-layer split can hide that real defects cascade across layers (a yarn fault becomes a fabric streak becomes a garment reject)
cons.example: treating a barre streak as only a finished-garment defect when its root is yarn count-CV

failure_modes: collapsing the three layers and trying to own yarn QC instead of demanding it

nodes.definition: State the supporting yarn-spec dials beyond evenness, each mapped to one thing the customer or the machine feels: a hairiness (H/S3) ceiling band because too-high hairiness drives pilling (the #1 return risk) while too-low looks flat and harsh; a tenacity/elongation minimum (breaking force in cN/tex plus stretch) so the yarn does not break in knitting (downtime) or seams (returns); and the actual count (Ne/Nm) with a count-CV ceiling so the count does not drift lot-to-lot, which would shift GSM and shade between batches. conflict_axes.name: spec_on_paper_vs_willingness_to_reject
conflict_axes.description: A PO spec and bought tests are paper leverage; without a willingness to reject and a big-enough order the numbers are theatre.
poles: write the spec and trust it
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: treat every gate as theatre until the brand actually samples, grades and rejects; flag the order-size conditional honestly

conflict_axes.name: build_the_sensor_vs_build_the_loop
conflict_axes.description: The thread-checker idea is four layers; building the sensing-and-grading sensor reinvents Uster while only the code-back loop is the ownable sliver.
poles: build only the cheap code-back loop
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: buy L1/L2/L3 sense-and-grade via the PO; build only the ~$0-5k L4 loop on a numeric PO and reject-willingness

conflict_axes.name: vision_assist_vs_vision_replace
conflict_axes.description: AI vision is cheap consistency but a dataset-specific accuracy unproven on our fabrics cannot replace the human inspector's seam-and-shade judgment.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: use vision only as a triage/screening layer that assists the human; validate on our own swatches before trusting any number

conflict_axes.name: supplier_cert_vs_paid_lab_spot_check
conflict_axes.description: An integrated spinner can self-certify while a micro-spinner cannot, shifting the evenness check from a demanded cert to a brand-paid lab test.
poles: rely on a supplier USTER cert
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: demand the cert from a USTER-equipped spinner; for a micro-spinner route the check to a paid lab and budget it

conflict_axes.name: yarn_stage_clause_vs_garment_stage_test
conflict_axes.description: Pilling, shrinkage and twist can be specced as yarn-stage clauses or caught as finished-garment lab tests; a clause alone does not guarantee the post-wash grade.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: write the yarn-stage clause and confirm with the post-wash garment test; the clause and the test must agree

conflict_axes.name: now_near_free_qc_vs_later_capital_qc
conflict_axes.description: Near-free NOW QC (PO spec, AQL, lab spot-check, code-back loop) competes for attention with LATER capital QC (inspection rig, vision) that may never be justified.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: run all NOW near-free steps before any LATER capital; gate the rig/vision behind proven volume and validation

conflict_axes.name: supplier_accountability_qr_vs_consumer_passport_qr
conflict_axes.description: The buyer-to-supplier grade-code QR (accountability) is easily conflated with the consumer-facing digital-product-passport QR (traceability), which is a separate later option.
poles: build the consumer traceability QR now
build only the supplier accountability loop
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: build the buyer-to-supplier accountability loop now; defer the consumer DPP QR as a separate marketing-driven later option

edge_cases.description: A micro-spinner is asked for a USTER cert it cannot produce because it owns no tester
edge_cases.trigger: the demand posture meets a spinner with no in-house evenness testing
edge_cases.mitigation: route the evenness check to a USTER-equipped spinner or budget a brand-paid third-party lab spot-check as the cert fallback

edge_cases.description: A vendor 95% knit-defect accuracy is believed and deployed on our acrylic/blend knits untested
edge_cases.trigger: a dataset-specific (TILDA woven/jacquard) accuracy is read as transferring to our fabrics
edge_cases.mitigation: treat any accuracy claim as marketing until validated on our own pre-production swatches; keep vision an assist, not the authority

edge_cases.description: A code-back loop is built with no numeric PO spec behind it so there is nothing credible to grade
edge_cases.trigger: the L4 loop is treated as a standalone gadget rather than a contract instrument
edge_cases.mitigation: build the loop only on top of an existing numeric PO spec and a willingness to reject; otherwise it grades against nothing

edge_cases.description: The brand runs every QC gate but never actually rejects a lot, making the programme theatre
edge_cases.trigger: an out-of-AQL or out-of-spec lot arrives and is accepted anyway
edge_cases.mitigation: reject the lot per the written AQL plan; QC without a willingness to reject converts every other gate into theatre

edge_cases.description: 5% USTER is demanded on a mass acrylic lot, pricing it out for no felt benefit
edge_cases.trigger: a tighter-is-better instinct overrides the felt-benefit tier
edge_cases.mitigation: target 25% USTER on CVm%/IPI for mainstream acrylic/blend and reserve tighter only for a premium article

edge_cases.description: Blend drift substitutes cheaper fibre and the care label no longer matches the HTS line
edge_cases.trigger: a supplier quietly shifts the blend ratio out of tolerance
edge_cases.mitigation: specify the blend ratio with a +/- tolerance verified by fibre-composition test; a mismatch is both a cost-down and a duty-misdeclaration exposure

edge_cases.description: An anti-pill claim is accepted on a pre-wash grade or a vendor percentage instead of the post-wash gate
edge_cases.trigger: a pilling result before any wash, or a vendor anti-pill %, is taken on trust
edge_cases.mitigation: gate every anti-pill claim on ICI Pilling Box grade >=3-4 after at least one home wash, because washing drops the grade

edge_cases.description: A mock-linked lot is accepted as fully-fashioned and shipped under a fully-linked quality claim
edge_cases.trigger: an inspector misreads a mock-linked or overlocked seam as true loop-to-loop linking
edge_cases.mitigation: train the inspector to distinguish true linking from mock-linking and reject a seam-class substitution as both a defect and a misrepresentation

edge_cases.description: A fabricated per-sample Uster run cost or per-piece job-work rate is fed into the cost model
edge_cases.trigger: a missing number is invented to look precise rather than held UNKNOWN
edge_cases.mitigation: hold the per-sample Uster run and per-piece Ludhiana job-work rate UNKNOWN as named blockers and obtain a real quote before any margin use

edge_cases.description: The buyer-to-supplier accountability QR is conflated with the consumer digital-product-passport QR
edge_cases.trigger: a single QR initiative is scoped to do both accountability and consumer traceability
edge_cases.mitigation: build only the buyer-to-supplier grade-code loop now; defer the consumer DPP QR as a separate, later, marketing-driven option

edge_cases.description: A used fabric-inspection rig or vision layer is bought before proven repeat volume or accuracy validation
edge_cases.trigger: a LATER capital step is taken on enthusiasm ahead of the cheapest-first sequence
edge_cases.mitigation: exhaust the NOW near-free QC and require proven repeat volume plus validation on our samples before any LATER capital

edge_cases.description: A uniform shade drift or systematic out-of-spec passes the AQL defect count because the sample cannot see it
edge_cases.trigger: a lot-wide systematic fault that is not a per-piece defect the sampling plan counts
edge_cases.mitigation: pair AQL defect sampling with the lot-to-lot delta-E and dimensional lab tests that catch systematic, not per-piece, faults

workflow.action: Fix the three-layer model of where QC happens
workflow.description: Name yarn / fabric-knit / finished-garment as the three layers and who owns the machine at each
workflow.gate: all three layers are named with their machine owner and the finished-garment layer is identified as the only brand-owned one

workflow.action: Set the demand / own / buy posture
workflow.description: Assign demand-via-PO to sense-and-grade, own to finished-garment AQL, buy to lab confirmation
workflow.gate: each posture is assigned to its layer with the micro-brand proportionality stated

workflow.action: Write the contractual numeric yarn spec
workflow.description: Enumerate CVm%/IPI <=25% USTER, hairiness ceiling, tenacity floor, count + count-CV, fibre composition
workflow.gate: every parameter is numeric, the 25%-not-5% USTER target is stated, and any unpinned cost is labeled estimate or UNKNOWN

workflow.action: Tie fibre composition to the duty guard
workflow.description: State the blend ratio + tolerance and the care-label/HTS match as a duty-misdeclaration guard
workflow.gate: the blend ratio has a +/- tolerance verified by test and is tied to the care-label/HTS duty match

workflow.description: State the in-line clearer and off-line tester as six-figure-class capital the brand demands not owns
workflow.gate: the instruments are named, prices held as labeled estimates/UNKNOWN, and the never-own conclusion stated as price-insensitive

workflow.action: Define the AQL plan and the owned garment inspection
workflow.description: State the ISO 2859-1 Critical 0 / Major 2.5 / Minor 4.0 plan and the measurement/seam/visual/label checklist
workflow.gate: the AQL acceptance levels and the full checklist are stated, with the seam/linking check called out

workflow.action: Make the reject decision the teeth of QC
workflow.description: State that QC without a willingness to reject is theatre and flag the order-size conditional
workflow.gate: the node ties the reject decision to converting paper leverage into real leverage and names the order-size conditional

workflow.action: Budget the bought third-party lab tests
workflow.description: State the ~$30-250/lot estimate, the UNKNOWN per-sample Uster run, and the tests bought (pilling/shrinkage/fastness/composition/evenness)
workflow.gate: the cost band is labeled an estimate, the per-sample Uster run is UNKNOWN as a blocker, and it is identified as the recurring cost line feeding T4

workflow.action: Gate pilling, dimensional and colour tests on thresholds
workflow.description: State ICI >=3-4 post-wash, shrinkage/spirality within tolerance, and fastness/delta-E thresholds
workflow.gate: each bought test names a standard and a written-into-PO pass threshold

workflow.action: Decompose the thread-checker and isolate the code-back loop
workflow.description: Split into L1 sense-yarn / L2 sense-knit / L3 grade / L4 code-back with build/don't-build verdicts
workflow.gate: each layer gets a verdict, sensing+grading is buy-via-PO, and the ~$0-5k L4 loop is the one ownable build

workflow.description: Keep the dataset-transfer caveat loud and vision as an assist not a replacement
workflow.gate: the 91-96% numbers are flagged dataset-specific, accuracy on our fabrics is UNKNOWN until validated, and AI assists not replaces the inspector

workflow.action: Compose the cheapest-first sequence and merged verdict
workflow.description: Order NOW (PO+AQL+lab+loop) / LATER (rig/vision post-validation) / NEVER (own tester/build sensor) into the own-demand-buy verdict
workflow.gate: the verdict states demand sense-and-grade, own only the AQL gate plus lab budget, build only the L4 loop, and gate vision behind validation

priority_rationale: The three-layer model and the demand/own/buy posture come first because every QC decision depends on knowing which layer the brand owns versus demands versus buys; the USTER benchmark base and the PO-as-QC principle next, because the numeric contract is the brand's cheapest highest-leverage instrument; the numeric yarn spec and its CVm%/IPI, supporting dials and composition clauses then make that contract concrete; the supplier-owned instruments and the AQL plan, lab budget and inspection-labour line establish what is demanded, bought and owned; the owned garment inspection, the reject-willingness gate and the bought pilling and finished-garment tests are the operating QC; the thread-checker decomposition, code-back loop and AI-vision verdict resolve the owner's device idea into a don't-build-sensor/build-loop call; and the micro-spinner cert gap, cheapest-first sequence and merged ownership verdict come last because they compose every upstream output into a defensible own-demand-buy plan.

dominance_rules.rule: The honesty label dominates any cost, price, throughput or rate claim
dominance_rules.rationale: no money or capacity figure here is firm, so a band may never be presented as fake-precise and a missing number stays UNKNOWN
dominance_rules.trigger: a cost, price, throughput, MOQ or man-day/job-work rate is stated
dominance_rules.action: tag it estimate with method and confidence, or UNKNOWN as a named blocker; never fabricate a precise figure

dominance_rules.rationale: the sensing-and-grading instruments are six-figure supplier-owned capital disproportionate to a $1-2.50/garment input
dominance_rules.trigger: a plan proposes owning a tester, a clearer, or building the thread-checker sensor
dominance_rules.action: replace ownership with a numeric PO demand against the supplier's existing capital

dominance_rules.rule: Willingness-to-reject dominates the existence of a spec
dominance_rules.rationale: a PO clause and bought tests are paper leverage with no teeth absent an actual reject
dominance_rules.trigger: a QC gate is run but no out-of-spec lot is ever rejected
dominance_rules.action: reject the lot per the AQL plan, and flag where order size makes the reject conditional

dominance_rules.rule: The post-wash pilling gate dominates a pre-wash or vendor anti-pill claim
dominance_rules.rationale: washing drops the pilling grade and the post-wash grade is what predicts returns
dominance_rules.trigger: an anti-pill claim rests on a pre-wash grade or a vendor percentage
dominance_rules.action: require ICI Pilling Box grade >=3-4 after at least one home wash before accepting the claim

dominance_rules.rule: Validation on our fabrics dominates a vendor vision-accuracy number
dominance_rules.rationale: cited 91-96% accuracies are dataset-specific (woven/jacquard) and untested on our acrylic/blend knits
dominance_rules.trigger: a vision accuracy is quoted or a vision layer is proposed as the authority
dominance_rules.action: treat the number as marketing until validated on our own swatches and keep vision an assist to the human inspector

dominance_rules.rule: The numeric PO spec dominates the code-back loop's standalone appeal
dominance_rules.rationale: the L4 loop has nothing credible to grade against without the numeric spec and a willingness to reject
dominance_rules.trigger: the code-back loop is treated as a freestanding gadget
dominance_rules.action: build the loop only on top of an existing numeric PO spec and reject-willingness

dominance_rules.rule: The 25% USTER felt-benefit tier dominates a tighter-is-better instinct
dominance_rules.rationale: 5% USTER on mass acrylic is unquotable or luxury-priced for a fineness the customer never feels
dominance_rules.trigger: a percentile tighter than the product tier is demanded on a mainstream lot
dominance_rules.action: target 25% USTER on CVm%/IPI and reserve tighter only for a premium article that is felt

dominance_rules.rule: Near-free NOW QC dominates LATER capital QC in sequencing
dominance_rules.rationale: the PO spec, AQL, lab spot-check and code-back loop deliver most of the leverage at near-zero capital
dominance_rules.trigger: a capital rig or vision layer is proposed before the near-free steps are running
dominance_rules.action: run all NOW steps first and gate any LATER capital behind proven volume and validation

anti_rework_rules.rule: Write the yarn spec as numbers with USTER percentiles and tolerances from the first PO, not adjectives
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a vague quality wish that cannot be sampled or rejected and must be renegotiated lot by lot

anti_rework_rules.rule: State the blend ratio with a +/- tolerance verified by composition test at PO time
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a blend-drift cost-down hardening into a care-label/HTS duty misdeclaration discovered at import

anti_rework_rules.rule: Confirm whether the chosen spinner can self-test before relying on a demanded USTER cert
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a demand posture stalling on a micro-spinner who owns no tester and re-routing the check late

anti_rework_rules.rule: Gate every anti-pill claim on a post-wash ICI grade in the same step the claim is made
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a pre-wash or vendor anti-pill claim shipping and returning as the #1 post-purchase complaint

anti_rework_rules.rule: Validate any vision-accuracy number on our own pre-production swatches before deploying it
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a dataset-specific accuracy proving false on our knits after a vision layer is already trusted as authority

anti_rework_rules.rule: Build the code-back loop only on an existing numeric PO spec and reject-willingness
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a freestanding L4 gadget that grades against nothing and has to be rebuilt on a real spec

anti_rework_rules.rule: Hold the per-sample Uster run and per-piece Ludhiana job-work rate UNKNOWN until quoted
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a fabricated cost line entering the T4 margin model and being retracted when a real quote lands

anti_rework_rules.rule: Keep the buyer-to-supplier accountability QR separate from the consumer passport QR from the outset
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a conflated QR initiative that must be split apart when the consumer DPP is scoped later

iteration_protocol.trigger: a real third-party lab quote near Ludhiana or a per-sample Uster run rate is obtained
iteration_protocol.action: replace the labeled lab-cost band and the UNKNOWN per-sample rate with confirmed figures and re-rank confidence into the cost line that feeds T4

iteration_protocol.trigger: a vision model is validated (or fails) on our own pre-production swatches
iteration_protocol.action: replace the UNKNOWN our-fabric accuracy and re-decide whether vision enters the LATER sequence as a screening layer

iteration_protocol.trigger: a target Ludhiana spinner's evenness-testing capability is confirmed at sourcing
iteration_protocol.action: re-route the evenness check between a demanded supplier cert and a brand-paid lab spot-check

iteration_protocol.trigger: a spinner is shown to act on or ignore a returned grade code
iteration_protocol.action: re-evaluate the code-back loop's conditional leverage and the order-size threshold behind it

iteration_protocol.trigger: a per-piece Ludhiana job-work rate or AQL inspection man-day quote lands
iteration_protocol.action: replace the UNKNOWN/estimate inspection cost line and feed the confirmed rate into the T4 cost model

iteration_protocol.trigger: sampling produces pilling-grade-by-construction curves for our exact knits
iteration_protocol.action: tighten the hairiness clause and the post-wash pilling threshold against the real curve

iteration_protocol.trigger: a USTER STATISTICS edition, ISO 2859-1/12945-1, or a duty line/surcharge is revised
iteration_protocol.action: update the percentile targets, AQL levels, pilling threshold and the composition duty guard against the new reference
